My background includes KYC checks, audits, and ensuring compliance with regulators like the CBUAE, OCC, FCA, BaFin. I excel in due diligence, adapting to the unique risks of clients in the UAE, US, UK, and DE. My expertise also covers verifying client data from sources such as Lexis Nexis and Bankers Almanac.

I am committed to driving strategic growth and maintaining regulatory standards through my experience in operational transformation and project execution.

AML Risk Assessment, Training & Governance

Client On-boarding

S K I L L S & C O M P E T E N C I E S

Business and Entrepreneurial skills:





Strong command of business and management principles, resource allocation, production methods, and leading others. Initiator and problem- solver using creativity, resourcefulness and assets to break down and overcome organizational obstacles

Goswami Goswami

Rishi , CAMS

W O R K E X P E R I E N C E

Ernst & Young, Dubai (Jan 2025 till date) Manager (KYC & AML)



Directed project management for KYC operations in the UAE, ensuring compliance with local banking regulations and standards set by the Central Bank of the UAE.



Recently worked with one of the UAE's major banks, where I managed a team of 200 people and successfully delivered the project.

·

Developed and presented comprehensive MIS reports.

Evaluated and documented the approval or rejection of compliance cases, providing detailed feedback and recommendations for process enhancements.



Collaborated with the compliance team to analyze case outcomes, identify trends, and implement preventive measures to reduce future rejections.



Proposed ideas for automating processes to enhance eﬃciency in current operations.

Ernst & Young, Bangalore (December 2021 till Jan 2025) Manager (KYC & AML)



Directed project management for KYC operations in compliance with banking standards set by the Central Bank of the UAE (CBUAE), ensuring adherence to local regulations.



Operational transformation across KYC, Screening, and AML processes, aligning with CBUAE guidelines to enhance efficiency and compliance



Developed and presented comprehensive Management Information System (MIS) reports that reﬂect CBUAE KYC requirements and operational metrics.



Fostered client and team interactions for optimal service delivery, ensuring that all KYC procedures meet the expectations of the CBUAE.



Leveraged 12+ years in banking and consulting, focusing on KYC and Transaction Monitoring, with a strong emphasis on compliance with CBUAE regulations.

Oaknorth Bank, Gurugram (June 2021 till December 2021) Senior Associate (Onboarding)

Job Roles & Responsibility: ·

Perform loan booking operations in line with UK banking norms (KYC/Due diligence/AML).



Perform in life loan management activities within the available systems pertaining to Syndication, Agency, Bilateral Loan operations.



Review Legal documents in terms of completeness and plausibility and Review & sign-oﬀ on legal documents

Manage Payment operations to process payments to external parties · Query and task management by Loan and customer type.

UBS, Hyderabad (May 2019 till June 2021) KYC Authorized officer (Manage team of 12 members)

Job Roles & Responsibility: ·

Lead the team on matters related to AML, KYC, working with the Front-line Origination Units to ensure all new clients are on-boarded correctly.



Ensure team performs active due diligence on clients, conducts quality assurance of customer AML KYC proﬁles of all risk ratings prepared by Front line Origination Units.

·

Focus on the assurance of quality and consistency in Client Due Diligence standards and achieving targets within stipulated timeframe across adoption locations.

Interpersonal and communication skills: 

Attentive listener and believe in participative decision making. Soft and hard skill training Motivated team player with excellent public speaking ability and communication





A C H I E V E M E N T S







Got the Award of Best Quality Performer of Month in April & June’12. Got the Award of Significant Contributor of the Month November 12. Core member of Back Oﬃce Case Resolution Team.

P R O F E S S I O N A L Q U A L I F I C A T I O N S

Master in Business Administration (Pursuing) from NMIMS (Specialization: International Trade Management)

Bachelor in Commerce (2013) from Rajasthan University

E D U C A T I O N A L Q U A L I F I C A T I O N S

Intermediate (2009) from S.A.P.S School

Matriculation (2006) from S.A.P.S School

C E R T I F I C A T I O N S

Certificate in effective communications and human relation, High impact presentation by Dale Carnegie & Associates, Inc

Client Identiﬁcation: ·

Facilitating the review of the overall AML Compliance program including risk analysis, periodic high risk account reviews, quality assurance reviews, and provide data on key performance indicators. Performing QA testing of KYC files, documenting any deficiencies/findings, and discussing these deﬁciencies/ﬁndings with AML Compliance Management; identiﬁed during QA testing. Providing support in coordinating/responding for requests for information for Internal Audit, Regulators and Law Enforcement as part of audits, examinations and investigations.





DBOI Global Services Private Limited, Jaipur (July 2013 till September 2016) Process Analyst

Job Roles & Responsibility: · ·

Review and adhere to DB Global KYC Policy & AML policies & procedure; Review completeness of a client's KYC (Know Your Customers) i.e. documentation/information and identifying missing documentation/information that needs to be obtained. Ensured compliance with all regulatory requirements, including Anti Money Laundering (AML) regulations such as USA PATRIOT ACT, BSA, FATCA, FCPA, OFAC Sanctions etc., Performing AML screening searches Performing QA (internal QC & 6 eye checks) To ensure KYC reviews are in accordance with all the prevailing regulatory guidelines, i.e. USA Patriot Act, 3rd EU MLD, MIFID Classiﬁcation, and Deutsche Bank’s internal AML policies. Also, to ensure completion of pipeline on time and with the highest standards of quality.



· ·

Teleperformance, Jaipur (September 2011 till July 2013)

Assistant Manager Call Center

Core Responsibilities: ·

Coaching, Team Meetings and giving feedback to enhance Customer experience. Call Monitoring / Customer complaint resolution / Team Building Activities. Handling Backend activity of a leading E-Commerce Company.
